sentences.en: He produced a rabbit out of his hat by magic.
sentences.zh: 他从帽子里变出了一只兔子。

sentences.en: The prince was changed into a tree by magic.
The prince was turned by magic into a frog.
sentences.zh: 王子被施了魔法变成了一只青蛙。

有魔力的；魔法的；神奇的；（非正式）极好的
